<b>Silkspear</b> is a [[Skills|Skill]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to throw her [[Needle]] forward to pierce enemies. 

== Function ==
Hornet throws the [[Needle]] forward, piercing enemies. The Silkspear deals [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Needle|3x Needle]] [[Heavy Damage]] on hit.

If the spear hits a wall, it is retracted significantly faster. This means that hitting an enemy, followed by a wall, makes the Silkspear much quicker to cast while still dealing the same amount of damage.

Hornet is unable to perform regular Needle attacks until the Needle returns to her, potentially leaving her vulnerable to enemy attacks.

Silkspear is also used to free the [[Bell Beast]] to initiate her boss fight, and to clear a few walls of Silk in [[Mosshome]] located near the Bell Beast fight.

=== Modifiers ===
* [[Volt Filament]] electrifies Silkspear, increasing the damage by 25% and adding 2 ticks of 5 damage.
* [[Shaman Crest]] sheathes Silkspear in magical runes, increasing the damage by 40%.
** Volt Filament and Shaman Crest's damage increases add together to grant +65% damage.
* [[Egg of Flealia]] reduces the cost of Silkspear to 3 Silk while at full health.

== How to Acquire ==
Silkspear can be acquired from a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] in [[Mosshome]] of [[Bone Bottom]].

* While Silkspear resembles one of Hornet's attacks [[Hornet Protector|as a boss in Hollow Knight]], it is much faster and flashier, being surrounded by glowing Silk and a magical rune.
